reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-configuration finding, not a dead-code check). Gate 2 skipped (no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json). Gate 3 passes (supabase/migrations/ is in-scope). Spec deviation confirmed: 20260317000001_fix_security_permissions.sql explicitly applied FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY to member and attendance schemas to prevent owner-level bypass, but the oauth schema (created in the later 20260318000000 migration) only uses ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all three oauth tables. The existing SECURITY DEFINER function oauth.cleanup_expired_codes() already executes as table owner, bypassing the USING(false) deny-all policy on oauth.authorization_codes, but its current body (deleting expired codes) is not directly exploitable. An attacker can trigger this via a SECURITY DEFINER function in the oauth schema by creating or modifying such a function to read or write oauth.authorization_codes, causing unauthorized access to active authorization codes that could be used to impersonate users; however, this currently requires code-level compromise, making the path uncertain.
